info.description:
System of record for motor and property claims across six APAC markets (SG, MY, HK, TH, ID, PH).
Every write goes through this API; claim events are published to Kafka for the insights service.

**Authentication.** HTTP Basic on every request (demo users: `claimant1`, `officer1`, `lead1`, `manager1`, password `password`). Click **Authorize** to try requests from this page.

**Roles.** `CLAIMANT` sees only their own claims. `OFFICER` and `MANAGER` see unassigned claims plus claims of people below them in the reporting line. Anything outside your scope returns **404**, not 403, so its existence is not revealed.

**Rules live on the server.** Each claim response lists `allowedActions` for the caller, who it is `waitingOn` and the `nextStep`, so clients never re-implement the workflow.

**Errors** are RFC 7807 Problem Details (`application/problem+json`): 400 validation (with an `errors` map per field), 401, 403, 404, 409 invalid state or concurrent update, 413 file too large, 415 unsupported file, 422 business rule.

**Idempotency.** Send an `Idempotency-Key` header when submitting a claim; a retry returns the original claim.

**Paging.** List endpoints take `page` (from 0) and `size` (1-100) and return `content`, `page`, `size`, `totalElements`, `totalPages`.
